entities.title: zazz-script-engine
entities.summary: The zazz-script-engine crate, library name zazz: the SDK zazz scripts are written and tested with, and the protocol code daemon and zazz-script-runner share with them.
entities.purpose: Holds the one copy of the script-side API (handlers, the call context, JSON, errors, HTTP), the launcher protocol both sides speak and the zazz::test harness, so a script, its tests, daemon and zazz-script-runner agree by construction. Contains the crate manifest (Cargo.toml, a member of the src/macos workspace) and the source in src/.
boundaries: No dependencies, only std: the daemon compiles the source files itself with rustc for each script build (Cargo.toml comment; src/macos/daemon/src/zazz/sdk.rs).
A library only: nothing is installed or released from this folder.
Building, sandboxing and calling scripts belong to daemon and zazz-script-runner; the .zazz file and zazz.json belong to zazz-script-packaging (src/macos/zazz-script/packaging).
